summary: GMR Solutions Inc. filed a routine 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that subsidiaries GMR Intermediate Corp. and Global Medical Response, Inc. entered Amendment No. 1 to its first lien credit agreement, repricing term loans and cutting the SOFR spread from +3.25% to +2.75% (about 50 bps). Concurrently, GMR, Inc. voluntarily prepaid roughly $200 million of first lien term loans with cash on hand, reducing principal to approximately $2.7 billion. Estimated annual cash interest savings are about $28 million; pro forma cash is about $188 million and total debt about $4.27 billion. This is a debt refinancing, not a special situation.
